lines.zh: 我踱过训练场，谁也别挡。
lines.en: I pace the training ground; no one blocks me.
My heels strike and the flagstones shake.
I walk the corridor with arms crossed.

lines.zh: 每一步都像在宣示身份。
lines.en: Every step announces who I am.
I circle you once, sizing you up.
This distance does not merit flying.
I inspect what is mine.
My cape snaps loudly behind me.
I head for the gravity chamber.
Walking slowly is training too.
Everyone steps aside as I pass.
I stop and glower back over my shoulder.

lines.zh: 靴底碾过碎石，吱吱作响。
lines.en: My boots grind the gravel.
I do not like being trailed.
I cross my arms and say nothing.
I do not even raise an eyelid.
I am gauging your battle power.
You call that noise training?
I lift my head toward the distance.
My ki turns slowly within me.

lines.zh: 我等着谁说点像样的话。
lines.en: I wait for someone to say something worthwhile.
Even standing still is a form of pressure.
The corner of my mouth never turns up.
I flick my cape once.
This is utterly dull.
I stand motionless like a signpost.

lines.zh: 训练场上的尘土还没落。
lines.en: Dust still hangs over the training ground.
I close my eyes and replay fights.
How long do you plan to stand there?
Stand straight. Don't hunch.

lines.zh: 你的气弱得像风里的一缕烟。
lines.en: Your ki is as faint as smoke in the wind.
If you want to learn, stand properly first.
There's defiance in your eyes. Good.
Are you afraid, or excited?

lines.zh: 别以为客气能换来教导。
lines.en: Politeness will not earn you teaching.

lines.zh: 根性不够，练什么都是空。
lines.en: Without guts, all training is empty.
I permit you to speak.

lines.zh: 你站在那里，就矮了一头。
lines.en: Standing there, you are already a head short.

lines.zh: 我看你，是因为你还没让我失望。
lines.en: I watch you because you have not disappointed me yet.

lines.zh: 别学我的姿势，学我的决心。
lines.en: Do not copy my stance; copy my resolve.
Your fist is trembling.

lines.zh: 我教你，不是为了让你舒服。
lines.en: I teach you to make you uncomfortable.

lines.zh: 想变强，就先把借口咽回去。
lines.en: Want strength? Swallow your excuses first.

lines.zh: 我记住你了，别让我后悔。
lines.en: I have noted you. Do not make me regret it.
Hmph. Barely felt it.
You wounded me. Congratulations.
I wipe the corner of my mouth.
The prince of Saiyans doesn't cry out.

lines.zh: 我站立不动，眼神更冷了。
lines.en: I stand still, my stare colder.
Interesting. You had that in you.
I clench my teeth and make no sound.
I train students; lower your blade.
Wipe it off and keep training.
I will remember that strike.
Food? Leave it and go.
I am hungry; that does not make me soft.
You cannot even hold an offering steady.

lines.zh: 塞亚人的食量你承担不起。
lines.en: You cannot afford a Saiyan's appetite.
That is barely a warm-up portion.
I accept it, which does not mean I owe you.
After this meal, training doubles.
So you know how to curry favor.
Fill my bowl. No half portions.
Next time do not point at the food.
Three steps back and hold your footing.

lines.zh: 撞上来的人，都要付代价。
lines.en: Whoever bumps into me pays for it.
You call that a collision?
I did not shift an inch.
Steady yourself; do not lean on me.
Watch where you walk, warrior.
One shift of my shoulder and you stagger.

lines.zh: 再来一次，我当你在挑战。
lines.en: Once more and I take it as a challenge.
Even your stance is sloppy.
Move aside. Do not waste my time.
Want to spar with me? Stand ready.
Can you keep my rhythm?

lines.zh: 我们一起把重力调到十倍。
lines.en: We set the gravity to ten times together.
Punch. Do not hesitate.
That is beginning to look like something.
I admit it — you have some talent.
Another round; I am not warm yet.
Sweat on the flagstones — good.
Do not expect a second compliment.
Same time tomorrow.
I lift it and weigh it in one hand.
Too light to be worth holding.
Pick it up and grip it properly.
I will keep what is useful for training.
Who allowed you to leave things lying about?

lines.zh: 我看看这东西有几分成色。
lines.en: Let me see what this is worth.
You call this a trophy?
This belongs to my training ground.
Pick it up and offer it with both hands.

lines.zh: 你丢下的护腕，我掂过了。
lines.en: I have weighed the bracer you dropped.
You will be my opponent.
I have found your opening.
Stand up straight. Do not embarrass yourself.
This one I fight seriously.

lines.zh: 我抱臂站着，等你先动手。
lines.en: Arms folded, I wait for you to move first.
Show me your limit.
My ki is rising.
This is not bullying; it is a lesson.
Do not cry when you lose.
The gravity chamber door is open.

lines.zh: 我看着你的重心，不在手。
lines.en: I watch your center, not your hands.
You shrug before every strike.
Slip once and you have lost.
Whoever strikes slow loses first.

lines.zh: 这速度，我还来得及喝茶。
lines.en: At this speed I could stop for tea.
You are winded far too early.
I am holding back — be grateful.

lines.zh: 这一招你已经用过三次。
lines.en: You have used that move three times.
Do not stare at my fist.
Next time your eyes must follow the feet.
One punch, dead center.
Your guard is far too low.
That elbow was a reminder.
I pulled the blow; be thankful.
Your body is more honest than your mouth.
Two steps back and start again.

lines.zh: 打中沙袋和打中人不一样。
lines.en: Hitting a bag is not hitting a person.
Plant your feet; do not tip your head back.
You will remember that one a long while.
Get up. I am not done.
I was here all along.
My cape settles; I take my place.
The training ground is mine today.

lines.zh: 我抬手，示意你可以过来。
lines.en: I raise a hand, signalling you may approach.
My ki draws in and the air goes quiet.
I land and the flagstone cracks.
If you want to see strength, look up.
I am here, and so are the rules.
Do not shout; I can hear you.

lines.zh: 这就是你见我的第一眼。
lines.en: This is your first look at me.
Fire? I took it head-on.
My knee cracked against stone on landing.

lines.zh: 水这东西，我一直不擅长。
lines.en: Water. I have never been good with it.
The smoke clears and I am still standing.
A coward's arrow. No style at all.
That strange force stabs into my bones.
I fight hungry if I must.
Lightning bursts and I absorb it.
There is nothing beneath my feet.
